MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

3. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 11

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

7. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 16

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

12. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

14. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²

5. c = 5
